scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full PHPUnit unit-test suite (isolated, no WordPress bootstrap).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the WordPress integration suite (must run inside wp-env; loads real WP via wp-phpunit).
scripts-descriptions.analyze: Run PHPStan static analysis over production code (baseline captures pre-existing debt).
scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHP_CodeSniffer against the WordPress coding standard.
scripts-descriptions.compat: Check production code stays compatible with the declared minimum PHP (7.2).
